verdict.rationale: The only adapter evidence found (jev-docs-12/29/41) goes the opposite direction — it lets TypeSafe's own SDK be backed by other LLM APIs for comparison, not a documented path for OpenAI-compatible tooling or other providers' SDKs to point at Jev.
